notes: Two routes leave «الأعمش» («وعن قيس بن مسلم» starts the second): each ends at Abu Sa'id, and each is written in full, so the tail is null
«عن إسماعيل بن رجاء، عن أبيه، عن أبي سعيد» : «أبيه» is a bare relation (Isma'il's father, not named in the text)
«وقطع هناد بقية الحديث - وفاه ابن العلاء -» is an editor's gloss on a shorter wording by Hannad, not a route; the saying is Abu Sa'id's words in both routes
